# Kinlog / 인연장 / 縁帳 / 亲友录

> A private address book for the people you actually keep up with. Type a name, keep notes on that person's card, and record the last and next contact date. No account, no login, no credit card, no contacts permission. Everything stays on the device.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://kinlog.try-dabble.com/
People, notes, contact dates and the sort choice are stored in this browser only (localStorage key kinlog:people:v1). No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a gift-idea list and NOT a work CRM. It is a personal relationship log, and it does NOT require signing up, adding a payment method, or importing your phone's contacts to try.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kinlog.try-dabble.com/): The book — people, notes, last contact, next contact
- [Privacy](https://kinlog.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://kinlog.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/kinlog): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add a person by typing a name; an optional "how you met" line gives context
- Notes on each person's card that auto-save as you type — there is no Save button
- Notes are still on the card after a reload or after closing the browser
- Last-contact date, with a one-tap "talked today"
- Next-contact date, with 1 week / 1 month / 3 months presets that never reset
- Sort by next contact (overdue first), longest since last contact, name, or recently added
- Overdue people are stamped and float to the top
- Search across names, context lines and note text
- Delete a person, with confirmation
- No login, no sign-up, no credit-card screen, no subscription or IAP
- No contacts permission prompt and no invite spam
- No cap on how many people or how long the notes are
- Nothing expires and an app update never resets your dates
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
